public-management.name: Public management
public-management.audience: Municipalities, state governments and federal agencies
public-management.text: Identify priority municipalities and populations, anticipate critical situations and direct policies, investments and drought response measures.

researchers.name: Technicians and researchers
researchers.text: Combine climate series, environmental indicators and socioeconomic data to follow trends, assess impacts and delimit vulnerable areas.

communities.name: Society and communities
communities.text: Understand how the territory is changing, recognize risk situations and strengthen living with drought and the sustainable use of natural resources.
